description: This file extends jQuery with additional AJAX event handling functions, allowing users to attach callbacks for various AJAX lifecycle events.

methods.name: ajaxStart
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'ajaxStart' event, triggered when an AJAX request starts.

methods.name: ajaxStop
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'ajaxStop' event, triggered when all AJAX requests have completed.

methods.name: ajaxComplete
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'ajaxComplete' event, triggered when an AJAX request completes.

methods.name: ajaxError
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'ajaxError' event, triggered when an AJAX request fails.

methods.name: ajaxSuccess
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'ajaxSuccess' event, triggered on successful AJAX requests.

methods.name: ajaxSend
methods.description: Registers a callback for the 'ajaxSend' event, triggered when an AJAX request is sent.
